# vrmid 1
```{r}
library(genlasso)
library(e1071)
library(glmnet)
```

##Anticipatory probes 

### prepare data
```{r}
time_end=10
time_start=0
duration = time_end-time_start
# 1. Keep only first 8 seconds of each trial
vrmid1_pupil_svr_data <- vrmid1_pupil_data %>%
  filter(Time_sec <= time_end, Time_sec >= time_start, probe == "anti") %>%
  select(Subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n, arousal, pupil_Avg_scaled) %>%
  mutate(sample_in_trial_n = as.numeric(sample_in_trial_n)) %>%  # ensure numeric ordering
  arrange(Subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_in_trial_n,
    values_from = pupil_Avg_scaled
  ) %>%
  select(Subject, trial, arousal,
    all_of(as.character(1:(duration*120)))
  )

# 4. Subject-level cross-validation folds
subjects <- unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject)
k <- 10  # 10-fold cross-validation

set.seed(42)
fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(subjects)))  # random fold assignment
subject_folds <- data.frame(Subject = subjects, Fold = fold_ids)

```

### SVR
```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV ---
# Store subject-wise results (RMSE, R2, Correlation)
weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results <- data.frame(Subject = integer(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric(), acc = numeric())

# Store pooled predictions: Subject, True Value, Predicted Value
weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_all_preds <- data.frame(
 Subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))

n_subjects <- length(unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject))

weights_vrmid1_ant_svr <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr) <- feature_cols

subjects <- unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject)

for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {
 test_subject <- subjects[i]

 train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject != test_subject)
 test_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject == test_subject)

 # Check for sufficient training data (optional, but good practice)
 if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
  warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
  next
 }
 
 model <- svm(x = train_data[, feature_cols], y = train_data$arousal,
       kernel = "radial", type = "eps-regression")

 # Identify rows in test data that have NA in features or true values
 row_all_na <- apply(cbind(test_data[, feature_cols], test_data$arousal), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
 
 preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data[!row_all_na, feature_cols])

 true_vals <- test_data$arousal[!row_all_na]

 # Compute training mean for proper LOSO R² for *this subject*
 train_mean <- mean(train_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 1. Proper Subject-level LOSO R²
 r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((true_vals - train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 2. Subject-level RMSE
 rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

 # 3. Subject-level Correlation (Accuracy)
 acc <- cor(preds, true_vals, use = "complete.obs")


 # Save subject-wise results
 weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results <- rbind(
  weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
 )
 
 # Save pooled predictions for overall metrics
 weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_all_preds <- rbind(
  weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_all_preds,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals, y_pred = preds)
 )

 # Compute feature weights
 # NOTE: This part remains unchanged and uses the model from the current fold
 w <- t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV
 weights_vrmid1_ant_svr[i, ] <- w
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## 📊 Subject-Wise and Average CV Performance

# Print subject-wise results
print(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results)

# Calculate and print average CV performance (mean of subject-wise metrics)
mean_RMSE <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_R2 <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results$R2, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_acc <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_results$acc, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("--- Average Subject-Wise CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Average CV RMSE:", mean_RMSE, "\n")
cat("Average CV R^2:", mean_R2, "\n")
cat("Average CV Correlation (Accuracy):", mean_acc, "\n")


## Overall (Pooled) CV Performance
# The 'Overall' or 'Pooled' CV metrics are calculated on ALL predictions from ALL folds together.

# Extract pooled true and predicted values
pooled_y_true <- weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_all_preds$y_true
pooled_y_pred <- weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_all_preds$y_pred

# Calculate the overall mean of the FULL training set to compute correct LOSO R²
# In LOSO, the overall R^2 should use the mean of the entire dataset (or the grand mean of all training sets)
# The mean of the entire 'arousal' column across all data is the most common approach for overall R^2.
overall_train_mean <- mean(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)


# 1. Overall (Pooled) CV RMSE
overall_rmse <- sqrt(mean((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Overall (Pooled) CV R²
# R² = 1 - (Sum of Squared Errors) / (Total Sum of Squares around the grand mean)
overall_r2 <- 1 - sum((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((pooled_y_true - overall_train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Overall (Pooled) CV Correlation (Accuracy)
overall_acc <- cor(pooled_y_pred, pooled_y_true, use = "complete.obs")

cat("--- Overall (Pooled) CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Overall CV RMSE:", overall_rmse, "\n")
cat("Overall CV R^2:", overall_r2, "\n")
cat("Overall CV Correlation (Accuracy):", overall_acc, "\n")

# Average weights across folds
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr)

weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)

# Convert to seconds (120 Hz sampling)
weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df$Time_sec <- weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df$Timepoint / 120

write_csv(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df,"../../data/vrmid1/derivatives/weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df.csv")

weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_pic <- ggplot(weights_vrmid1_ant_svr_df, aes(x = Time_sec, y = Weight)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "darkred", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "feature weight",
    title = "VR Study",
    subtitle = "Anticipation probe",
  )+
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,4,6), size = 1, color = "grey")+
  annotate("text", x = 2,y = 0.1, label = "C",
          color = "black",size = unit(4,"pt"))+
  annotate("text", x = 5,y = 0.1, label = "F",
          color = "black",size = unit(4,"pt"))+
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.01, label = "R", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt"))
```

### GENLASSO (very slow)
```{r eval = F, echo=F}
# --- 4. Run subject-level CV using Fused Lasso with inner CV for lambda ---
weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_results <- data.frame(Fold = integer(), Accuracy = numeric())
feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))

weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso) <- feature_cols

set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("Processing fold", i, "\n")
  
  test_subjects <- subject_folds$Subject[subject_folds$Fold == i]
  
  train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(!Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fused Lasso: D is the difference operator for consecutive time points
  D <- diff(diag(ncol(x_train)))
  
  # Fit fused lasso over a grid of lambdas
  fused_model <- genlasso(y_train, x_train, D=D)
  
  # --- Inner CV to pick lambda ---
  # Split training data into 5-folds for inner CV
  inner_k <- 5
  inner_fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:inner_k, length.out = nrow(x_train)))
  inner_mse <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(fused_model$lambda), ncol=inner_k)
  
  for (j in 1:inner_k) {
    inner_train_idx <- which(inner_fold_ids != j)
    inner_val_idx   <- which(inner_fold_ids == j)
    
    x_inner_train <- x_train[inner_train_idx, ]
    y_inner_train <- y_train[inner_train_idx]
    x_inner_val   <- x_train[inner_val_idx, ]
    y_inner_val   <- y_train[inner_val_idx]
    
    # Fit inner model without lambda argument
  inner_model <- genlasso(y_inner_train, x_inner_train, D=D)
  
  # Interpolate to outer lambda grid
  for (l in 1:length(fused_model$lambda)) {
    # Find closest lambda in inner_model$lambda
    lambda_diff <- abs(inner_model$lambda - fused_model$lambda[l])
    closest_idx <- which.min(lambda_diff)
    
    beta_l <- inner_model$beta[, closest_idx]
    preds_l <- x_inner_val %*% beta_l
    inner_mse[l, j] <- mean((y_inner_val - preds_l)^2)
  }
  }
  
  # Average MSE across inner folds
  avg_inner_mse <- rowMeans(inner_mse)
  best_lambda_idx <- which.min(avg_inner_mse)
  beta_best <- fused_model$beta[, best_lambda_idx]
  
  # Predictions on test set
  preds <- x_test %*% beta_best
  
  # Remove rows with NA features
  row_all_na <- apply(x_test, 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  acc <- cor(preds[!row_all_na], y_test[!row_all_na], use = "complete.obs")
  weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_results <- rbind(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_results, data.frame(Fold = i, Accuracy = acc))
  
  # Store feature weights
  weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(beta_best)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---
cat("Mean CV Accuracy:", mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlass_results$Accuracy), "\n")
cat("RMSE:", sqrt(mean((preds - test_data$arousal)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")

# Average weights across folds
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso)

weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)

# Convert to seconds (120 Hz sampling)
weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df$Time_sec <- weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df$Timepoint / 120

write_csv(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df,"../../data/vrmid1/derivatives/weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df.csv")
# Plot
ggplot(weights_vrmid1_ant_genlasso_df, aes(x = Time_sec, y = Weight)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "darkred", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Fused Lasso weight (feature importance)",
    title = "Average Fused Lasso feature weights across CV folds"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,4,6), size = 1, color = "grey") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.01, label = "C", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.01, label = "F", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.01, label = "R", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt"))
```


### LASSO
```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV using Lasso ---

# Store subject-wise results
weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric(), acc = numeric()
)

# Store pooled predictions
weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_all_preds <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))
subjects <- unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject)
n_subjects <- length(subjects)

# Weight matrix (subject × features)
weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso) <- feature_cols


for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {

  test_subject <- subjects[i]
  
  train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject != test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject == test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  
  # Skip if too little training data
  if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
    next
  }
  
  # Extract matrices
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fit LASSO CV model (alpha=1 for pure lasso)
  cv_model <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, standardize = TRUE)
  best_lambda <- cv_model$lambda.min
  
  # Final model
  model <- glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda, standardize = FALSE)
  
  # Predictions
  preds <- predict(model, newx = x_test)
  preds <- as.numeric(preds)
  
  # Identify rows with any NA
  row_all_na <- apply(cbind(x_test, y_test), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  preds_clean <- preds[!row_all_na]
  true_vals_clean <- y_test[!row_all_na]
  
  # Compute LOSO metrics
  train_mean <- mean(y_train, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2) /
    sum((true_vals_clean - train_mean)^2)
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2))
  
  acc <- cor(preds_clean, true_vals_clean, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Store subject-wise results
  weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results <- rbind(
    weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results,
    data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
  )
  
  # Store pooled predictions
  weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_all_preds <- rbind(
    weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_all_preds,
    data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals_clean, y_pred = preds_clean)
  )
  
  # Feature weights
  weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(model$beta)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## Subject-wise results
print(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results)

mean_RMSE <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results$RMSE)
mean_R2 <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results$R2)
mean_acc <- mean(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_results$acc)

cat("--- Average Subject-Wise CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Average CV RMSE:", mean_RMSE, "\n")
cat("Average CV R^2:", mean_R2, "\n")
cat("Average CV Correlation (Accuracy):", mean_acc, "\n")

## Pooled performance
pooled_y_true <- weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_all_preds$y_true
pooled_y_pred <- weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_all_preds$y_pred

overall_train_mean <- mean(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$arousal,na.rm=T)

overall_rmse <- sqrt(mean((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2))
overall_r2 <- 1 - sum((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2) /
  sum((pooled_y_true - overall_train_mean)^2)

overall_acc <- cor(pooled_y_pred, pooled_y_true)

cat("--- Overall (Pooled) CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Overall CV RMSE:", overall_rmse, "\n")
cat("Overall CV R^2:", overall_r2, "\n")
cat("Overall CV Correlation (Accuracy):", overall_acc, "\n")

# --- 6. Average weights across subjects ---
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso, na.rm = TRUE)

weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)

weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_df$Time_sec <- weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_df$Timepoint / 120

# Plot
weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_pic <- ggplot(weights_vrmid1_ant_lasso_df, aes(x = Time_sec, y = Weight)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "darkred", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Feature weight",
    title = "VR Study",
    subtitle = "Anticipation probe"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,4,6), size = 1, color = "grey") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.01, label = "C", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.01, label = "F", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.01, label = "R", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt"))
```

### prepare data
```{r}
time_end=14
time_start=0
duration = time_end-time_start
# 1. Keep only first 8 seconds of each trial
vrmid1_pupil_svr_data <- vrmid1_pupil_data %>%
  filter(Time_sec <= time_end, Time_sec >= time_start, probe == "out") %>%
  select(Subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n, arousal, pupil_Avg_scaled) %>%
  mutate(sample_in_trial_n = as.numeric(sample_in_trial_n)) %>%  # ensure numeric ordering
  arrange(Subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_in_trial_n,
    values_from = pupil_Avg_scaled
  ) %>%
  select(Subject, trial, arousal,
    all_of(as.character(1:(duration*120)))
  )

# 4. Subject-level cross-validation folds

set.seed(42)
fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(subjects)))  # random fold assignment
```

### SVR
```{r warning=F,message =F}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV ---

)

feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))

n_subjects <- length(unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject))

weights_vrmid1_out_svr <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_out_svr) <- feature_cols

subjects <- unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject)

for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {
 test_subject <- subjects[i]

 train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject != test_subject)
 test_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject == test_subject)

 # Check for sufficient training data (optional, but good practice)
 if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
  warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
  next
 }
 
 model <- svm(x = train_data[, feature_cols], y = train_data$arousal,
       kernel = "radial", type = "eps-regression")

 # Identify rows in test data that have NA in features or true values
 row_all_na <- apply(cbind(test_data[, feature_cols], test_data$arousal), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
 
 preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data[!row_all_na, feature_cols])

 true_vals <- test_data$arousal[!row_all_na]

 # Compute training mean for proper LOSO R² for *this subject*
 train_mean <- mean(train_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 1. Proper Subject-level LOSO R²
 r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((true_vals - train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 2. Subject-level RMSE
 rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

 # 3. Subject-level Correlation (Accuracy)
 acc <- cor(preds, true_vals, use = "complete.obs")


 # Save subject-wise results
 weights_vrmid1_out_svr_results <- rbind(
  weights_vrmid1_out_svr_results,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
 )
 
 # Save pooled predictions for overall metrics
 weights_vrmid1_out_svr_all_preds <- rbind(
  weights_vrmid1_out_svr_all_preds,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals, y_pred = preds)
 )

 # Compute feature weights
 # NOTE: This part remains unchanged and uses the model from the current fold
 w <- t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV
 weights_vrmid1_out_svr[i, ] <- w
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## 📊 Subject-Wise and Average CV Performance

# Print subject-wise results
print(weights_vrmid1_out_svr_results)

# Calculate and print average CV performance (mean of subject-wise metrics)

## Overall (Pooled) CV Performance

pooled_y_pred <- weights_vrmid1_out_svr_all_preds$y_pred

# Calculate the overall mean of the FULL training set to compute correct LOSO R²
# In LOSO, the overall R^2 should use the mean of the entire dataset (or the grand mean of all training sets)
# The mean of the entire 'arousal' column across all data is the most common approach for overall R^2.
overall_train_mean <- mean(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)


# 1. Overall (Pooled) CV RMSE
overall_rmse <- sqrt(mean((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Overall (Pooled) CV R²
# R² = 1 - (Sum of Squared Errors) / (Total Sum of Squares around the grand mean)
overall_r2 <- 1 - sum((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((pooled_y_true - overall_train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Overall (Pooled) CV Correlation (Accuracy)
```

```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV using Lasso ---

# Store subject-wise results
weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric(), acc = numeric()
)

# Store pooled predictions
weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_all_preds <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))
subjects <- unique(vrmid1_pupil_svr_data$Subject)
n_subjects <- length(subjects)

# Weight matrix (subject × features)
weights_vrmid1_out_lasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_out_lasso) <- feature_cols


for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {

  test_subject <- subjects[i]
  
  train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject != test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject == test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  
  # Skip if too little training data
  if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
    next
  }
  
  # Extract matrices
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fit LASSO CV model (alpha=1 for pure lasso)
  cv_model <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, standardize = TRUE)
  best_lambda <- cv_model$lambda.min
  
  # Final model
  model <- glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda, standardize = FALSE)
  
  # Predictions
  preds <- predict(model, newx = x_test)
  preds <- as.numeric(preds)
  
  # Identify rows with any NA
  row_all_na <- apply(cbind(x_test, y_test), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  preds_clean <- preds[!row_all_na]
  true_vals_clean <- y_test[!row_all_na]
  
  # Compute LOSO metrics
  train_mean <- mean(y_train, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2) /
    sum((true_vals_clean - train_mean)^2)
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2))
  
  acc <- cor(preds_clean, true_vals_clean, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Store subject-wise results
  weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results <- rbind(
    weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results,
    data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
  )
  
  # Store pooled predictions
  weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_all_preds <- rbind(
    weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_all_preds,
    data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals_clean, y_pred = preds_clean)
  )
  
  # Feature weights
  weights_vrmid1_out_lasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(model$beta)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## Subject-wise results
print(weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results)

mean_RMSE <- mean(weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results$RMSE)
mean_R2 <- mean(weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results$R2)
mean_acc <- mean(weights_vrmid1_out_lasso_results$acc)

cat("--- Average Subject-Wise CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Average CV RMSE:", mean_RMSE, "\n")
cat("Average CV R^2:", mean_R2, "\n")
cat("Average CV Correlation (Accuracy):", mean_acc, "\n")

## Pooled performance
```

### GENLASSO (very slow)
```{r eval = F}
# --- 4. Run subject-level CV using Fused Lasso with inner CV for lambda ---
weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_results <- data.frame(Fold = integer(), Accuracy = numeric())
feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))

weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso) <- feature_cols

set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("Processing fold", i, "\n")
  
  test_subjects <- subject_folds$Subject[subject_folds$Fold == i]
  
  train_data <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(!Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- vrmid1_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fused Lasso: D is the difference operator for consecutive time points
  D <- diff(diag(ncol(x_train)))
  
  # Fit fused lasso over a grid of lambdas
  fused_model <- genlasso(y_train, x_train, D=D)
  
  # --- Inner CV to pick lambda ---
  # Split training data into 5-folds for inner CV
  inner_k <- 5
  inner_fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:inner_k, length.out = nrow(x_train)))
  inner_mse <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(fused_model$lambda), ncol=inner_k)
  
  for (j in 1:inner_k) {
    inner_train_idx <- which(inner_fold_ids != j)
    inner_val_idx   <- which(inner_fold_ids == j)
    
    x_inner_train <- x_train[inner_train_idx, ]
    y_inner_train <- y_train[inner_train_idx]
    x_inner_val   <- x_train[inner_val_idx, ]
    y_inner_val   <- y_train[inner_val_idx]
    
    # Fit inner model without lambda argument
  inner_model <- genlasso(y_inner_train, x_inner_train, D=D)
  
  # Interpolate to outer lambda grid
  for (l in 1:length(fused_model$lambda)) {
    # Find closest lambda in inner_model$lambda
    lambda_diff <- abs(inner_model$lambda - fused_model$lambda[l])
    closest_idx <- which.min(lambda_diff)
    
    beta_l <- inner_model$beta[, closest_idx]
    preds_l <- x_inner_val %*% beta_l
    inner_mse[l, j] <- mean((y_inner_val - preds_l)^2)
  }
  }
  
  # Average MSE across inner folds
  avg_inner_mse <- rowMeans(inner_mse)
  best_lambda_idx <- which.min(avg_inner_mse)
  beta_best <- fused_model$beta[, best_lambda_idx]
  
  # Predictions on test set
  preds <- x_test %*% beta_best
  
  # Remove rows with NA features
  row_all_na <- apply(x_test, 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  acc <- cor(preds[!row_all_na], y_test[!row_all_na], use = "complete.obs")
  weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_results <- rbind(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_results, data.frame(Fold = i, Accuracy = acc))
  
  # Store feature weights
  weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(beta_best)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---
print(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_results)
cat("Mean CV Accuracy:", mean(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_results$Accuracy), "\n")

# Average weights across folds
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso)

weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)


# Convert to seconds (120 Hz sampling)
weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df$Time_sec <- weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df$Timepoint / 120

write_csv(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df,"../../data/vrmid1/derivatives/weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df.csv")

# Plot
ggplot(weights_vrmid1_out_genlasso_df, aes(x = Time_sec, y = Weight)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "darkred", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Fused Lasso weight (feature importance)",
    title = "Average Fused Lasso feature weights across CV folds"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,4,6), size = 1, color = "grey") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.01, label = "C", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.01, label = "F", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.01, label = "R", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt"))
```

# FMRI study

### prepare data
```{r}
time_end=8
time_start=0
duration = time_end-time_start
# 1. Keep only first 8 seconds of each trial
fmri3_pupil_svr_data <- fmri3_pupil_data %>%
  filter(Time_sec <= time_end, Time_sec >= time_start, probe == 1,
         rating_type == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n, arousal, pupilDiameter_scaled) %>%
  mutate(sample_in_trial_n = as.numeric(sample_in_trial_n)) %>%  # ensure numeric ordering
  arrange(subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_in_trial_n,
    values_from = pupilDiameter_scaled
  ) %>%
  select(subject, trial, arousal,
    all_of(as.character(2:(duration*120+1))) #1 has a lot of missing
  )

# 4. Subject-level cross-validation folds
subjects <- unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject)
k <- 10  # 10-fold cross-validation

set.seed(42)
fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(subjects)))  # random fold assignment
subject_folds <- data.frame(subject = subjects, Fold = fold_ids)
```

```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV ---
# Store subject-wise results (RMSE, R2, Correlation)

 subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

subjects <- unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject)

for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {
 test_subject <- subjects[i]

 train_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject != test_subject)
 test_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject == test_subject)

 # Check for sufficient training data (optional, but good practice)
 if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
  warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
  next
 }
 
 model <- svm(x = train_data[, feature_cols], y = train_data$arousal,
       kernel = "radial", type = "eps-regression")

 # Identify rows in test data that have NA in features or true values
 row_all_na <- apply(cbind(test_data[, feature_cols], test_data$arousal), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
 
 preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data[!row_all_na, feature_cols])

 true_vals <- test_data$arousal[!row_all_na]

 # Compute training mean for proper LOSO R² for *this subject*
 train_mean <- mean(train_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 1. Proper subject-level LOSO R²
 r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((true_vals - train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 2. Subject-level RMSE
 rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

 # 3. Subject-level Correlation (Accuracy)
 acc <- cor(preds, true_vals, use = "complete.obs")


 # Save subject-wise results
 weights_fmri3_ant_svr_results <- rbind(
  weights_fmri3_ant_svr_results,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
 )
 
 # Save pooled predictions for overall metrics
 weights_fmri3_ant_svr_all_preds <- rbind(
  weights_fmri3_ant_svr_all_preds,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals, y_pred = preds)
 )

 # Compute feature weights
 # NOTE: This part remains unchanged and uses the model from the current fold
 w <- t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV
 weights_fmri3_ant_svr[i, ] <- w
}
```

```{r}
  acc <- cor(preds_clean, true_vals_clean, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Store subject-wise results
  weights_fmri3_ant_lasso_results <- rbind(
    weights_fmri3_ant_lasso_results,
    data.frame(subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
  )
  
  # Store pooled predictions
  weights_fmri3_ant_lasso_all_preds <- rbind(
    weights_fmri3_ant_lasso_all_preds,
    data.frame(subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals_clean, y_pred = preds_clean)
  )
  
  # Feature weights
  weights_fmri3_ant_lasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(model$beta)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---
```

### GENLASSO (very slow)
```{r eval = F, echo=F}
# --- 4. Run subject-level CV using Fused Lasso with inner CV for lambda ---
weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_results <- data.frame(Fold = integer(), Accuracy = numeric())
feature_cols <- as.character(1:(time_end*120))

weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso) <- feature_cols

set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("Processing fold", i, "\n")
  
  test_subjects <- subject_folds$Subject[subject_folds$Fold == i]
  
  train_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(!Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(Subject %in% test_subjects) %>% drop_na()
  
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fused Lasso: D is the difference operator for consecutive time points
  D <- diff(diag(ncol(x_train)))
  
  # Fit fused lasso over a grid of lambdas
  fused_model <- genlasso(y_train, x_train, D=D)
  
  # --- Inner CV to pick lambda ---
  # Split training data into 5-folds for inner CV
  inner_k <- 5
  inner_fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:inner_k, length.out = nrow(x_train)))
  inner_mse <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(fused_model$lambda), ncol=inner_k)
  
  for (j in 1:inner_k) {
    inner_train_idx <- which(inner_fold_ids != j)
    inner_val_idx   <- which(inner_fold_ids == j)
    
    x_inner_train <- x_train[inner_train_idx, ]
    y_inner_train <- y_train[inner_train_idx]
    x_inner_val   <- x_train[inner_val_idx, ]
    y_inner_val   <- y_train[inner_val_idx]
    
    # Fit inner model without lambda argument
  inner_model <- genlasso(y_inner_train, x_inner_train, D=D)
  
  # Interpolate to outer lambda grid
  for (l in 1:length(fused_model$lambda)) {
    # Find closest lambda in inner_model$lambda
    lambda_diff <- abs(inner_model$lambda - fused_model$lambda[l])
    closest_idx <- which.min(lambda_diff)
    
    beta_l <- inner_model$beta[, closest_idx]
    preds_l <- x_inner_val %*% beta_l
    inner_mse[l, j] <- mean((y_inner_val - preds_l)^2)
  }
  }
  
  # Average MSE across inner folds
  avg_inner_mse <- rowMeans(inner_mse)
  best_lambda_idx <- which.min(avg_inner_mse)
  beta_best <- fused_model$beta[, best_lambda_idx]
  
  # Predictions on test set
  preds <- x_test %*% beta_best
  
  # Remove rows with NA features
  row_all_na <- apply(x_test, 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  acc <- cor(preds[!row_all_na], y_test[!row_all_na], use = "complete.obs")
  weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_results <- rbind(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_results, data.frame(Fold = i, Accuracy = acc))
  
  # Store feature weights
  weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(beta_best)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---
print(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_results)
cat("Mean CV Accuracy:", mean(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_results$Accuracy), "\n")

# Average weights across folds
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso)

weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)

# Convert to seconds (120 Hz sampling)
weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_df$Time_sec <- weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_df$Timepoint / 120

# Plot
ggplot(weights_fmri3_ant_genlasso_df, aes(x = Time_sec, y = Weight)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "darkred", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Feature weight",
    title = "FMRI Study",
    subtitle = "Anticipation probe"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,4,6), size = 1, color = "grey") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.01, label = "C", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.01, label = "F", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.01, label = "R", color = "black", size = unit(4,"pt"))
```

### prepare data
```{r}
time_end=12
time_start=0
duration = time_end-time_start
# 1. Keep only first 8 seconds of each trial
fmri3_pupil_svr_data <- fmri3_pupil_data %>%
  filter(Time_sec <= time_end, Time_sec >= time_start, probe == 2,
         rating_type == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n, arousal, pupilDiameter_scaled) %>%
  mutate(sample_in_trial_n = as.numeric(sample_in_trial_n)) %>%  # ensure numeric ordering
  arrange(subject, trial, sample_in_trial_n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_in_trial_n,
    values_from = pupilDiameter_scaled
  ) %>%
  select(subject, trial, arousal,
    all_of(as.character(2:(duration*120+1))) #1 has a lot of missing
  )

# 4. Subject-level cross-validation folds
subjects <- unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject)
k <- 10  # 10-fold cross-validation

set.seed(42)
fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(subjects)))  # random fold assignment
subject_folds <- data.frame(subject = subjects, Fold = fold_ids)
```

### SVR
```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV ---
# Store subject-wise results (RMSE, R2, Correlation)
weights_fmri3_out_svr_results <- data.frame(subject = integer(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric(), acc = numeric())

# Store pooled predictions: subject, True Value, Predicted Value
weights_fmri3_out_svr_all_preds <- data.frame(
 subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

feature_cols <- as.character(2:(time_end*120))

n_subjects <- length(unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject))

weights_fmri3_out_svr <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_fmri3_out_svr) <- feature_cols

subjects <- unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject)

for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {
 test_subject <- subjects[i]

 train_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject != test_subject)
 test_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject == test_subject)

 # Check for sufficient training data (optional, but good practice)
 if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
  warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
  next
 }
 
 model <- svm(x = train_data[, feature_cols], y = train_data$arousal,
       kernel = "radial", type = "eps-regression")

 # Identify rows in test data that have NA in features or true values
 row_all_na <- apply(cbind(test_data[, feature_cols], test_data$arousal), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
 
 preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data[!row_all_na, feature_cols])

 true_vals <- test_data$arousal[!row_all_na]

 # Compute training mean for proper LOSO R² for *this subject*
 train_mean <- mean(train_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 1. Proper subject-level LOSO R²
 r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((true_vals - train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

 # 2. Subject-level RMSE
 rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

 # 3. Subject-level Correlation (Accuracy)
 acc <- cor(preds, true_vals, use = "complete.obs")


 # Save subject-wise results
 weights_fmri3_out_svr_results <- rbind(
  weights_fmri3_out_svr_results,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
 )
 
 # Save pooled predictions for overall metrics
 weights_fmri3_out_svr_all_preds <- rbind(
  weights_fmri3_out_svr_all_preds,
  data.frame(Subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals, y_pred = preds)
 )

 # Compute feature weights
 # NOTE: This part remains unchanged and uses the model from the current fold
 w <- t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV
 weights_fmri3_out_svr[i, ] <- w
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## 📊 Subject-Wise and Average CV Performance

# Print subject-wise results
print(weights_fmri3_out_svr_results)

# Calculate and print average CV performance (mean of subject-wise metrics)
mean_RMSE <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_svr_results$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_R2 <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_svr_results$R2, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_acc <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_svr_results$acc, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("--- Average Subject-Wise CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Average CV RMSE:", mean_RMSE, "\n")
cat("Average CV R^2:", mean_R2, "\n")
cat("Average CV Correlation (Accuracy):", mean_acc, "\n")


## Overall (Pooled) CV Performance
# The 'Overall' or 'Pooled' CV metrics are calculated on ALL predictions from ALL folds together.

# Extract pooled true and predicted values
pooled_y_true <- weights_fmri3_out_svr_all_preds$y_true
pooled_y_pred <- weights_fmri3_out_svr_all_preds$y_pred

# Calculate the overall mean of the FULL training set to compute correct LOSO R²
# In LOSO, the overall R^2 should use the mean of the entire dataset (or the grand mean of all training sets)
# The mean of the entire 'arousal' column across all data is the most common approach for overall R^2.
overall_train_mean <- mean(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$arousal, na.rm = TRUE)


# 1. Overall (Pooled) CV RMSE
overall_rmse <- sqrt(mean((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Overall (Pooled) CV R²
# R² = 1 - (Sum of Squared Errors) / (Total Sum of Squares around the grand mean)
overall_r2 <- 1 - sum((pooled_y_true - pooled_y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((pooled_y_true - overall_train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Overall (Pooled) CV Correlation (Accuracy)
overall_acc <- cor(pooled_y_pred, pooled_y_true, use = "complete.obs")

cat("--- Overall (Pooled) CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Overall CV RMSE:", overall_rmse, "\n")
cat("Overall CV R^2:", overall_r2, "\n")
cat("Overall CV Correlation (Accuracy):", overall_acc, "\n")

# Average weights across folds
avg_weights <- colMeans(weights_fmri3_out_svr)

weights_fmri3_out_svr_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = as.numeric(feature_cols),
  Weight = avg_weights
)

# Convert to seconds (120 Hz sampling)

  )+
```

### LASSO
```{r}
# --- 4. Run subject-level LOSO CV using Lasso ---

# Store subject-wise results
weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric(), acc = numeric()
)

# Store pooled predictions
weights_fmri3_out_lasso_all_preds <- data.frame(
  Subject = integer(), y_true = numeric(), y_pred = numeric()
)

feature_cols <- as.character(2:(time_end*120+1))
subjects <- unique(fmri3_pupil_svr_data$subject)
n_subjects <- length(subjects)

# Weight matrix (subject × features)
weights_fmri3_out_lasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_subjects, ncol = length(feature_cols))
colnames(weights_fmri3_out_lasso) <- feature_cols


for (i in seq_along(subjects)) {

  test_subject <- subjects[i]
  
  train_data <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject != test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  test_data  <- fmri3_pupil_svr_data %>% filter(subject == test_subject) %>% drop_na()
  
  # Skip if too little training data
  if (nrow(train_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping subject", test_subject, "due to insufficient training data."))
    next
  }
  
  # Extract matrices
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols])
  y_train <- train_data$arousal
  
  x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[, feature_cols])
  y_test  <- test_data$arousal
  
  # Fit LASSO CV model (alpha=1 for pure lasso)
  cv_model <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, standardize = TRUE)
  best_lambda <- cv_model$lambda.min
  
  # Final model
  model <- glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda, standardize = FALSE)
  
  # Predictions
  preds <- predict(model, newx = x_test)
  preds <- as.numeric(preds)
  
  # Identify rows with any NA
  row_all_na <- apply(cbind(x_test, y_test), 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  
  preds_clean <- preds[!row_all_na]
  true_vals_clean <- y_test[!row_all_na]
  
  # Compute LOSO metrics
  train_mean <- mean(y_train, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  r2_cv <- 1 - sum((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2) /
    sum((true_vals_clean - train_mean)^2)
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals_clean - preds_clean)^2))
  
  acc <- cor(preds_clean, true_vals_clean, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Store subject-wise results
  weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results <- rbind(
    weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results,
    data.frame(subject = test_subject, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2_cv, acc = acc)
  )
  
  # Store pooled predictions
  weights_fmri3_out_lasso_all_preds <- rbind(
    weights_fmri3_out_lasso_all_preds,
    data.frame(subject = test_subject, y_true = true_vals_clean, y_pred = preds_clean)
  )
  
  # Feature weights
  weights_fmri3_out_lasso[i, ] <- as.numeric(model$beta)
}

# --- 5. Check performance ---

## Subject-wise results
print(weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results)

mean_RMSE <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results$RMSE)
mean_R2 <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results$R2)
mean_acc <- mean(weights_fmri3_out_lasso_results$acc)

cat("--- Average Subject-Wise CV Metrics ---\n")
cat("Average CV RMSE:", mean_RMSE, "\n")
cat("Average CV R^2:", mean_R2, "\n")
cat("Average CV Correlation (Accuracy):", mean_acc, "\n")

## Pooled performance
```
